title: analysis.state.compare request
description: Compare two or more state snapshots field by field, writing nothing. `read_only`. Alignment is by field path, not by address, so a port that lays the same state out differently still compares. A document this build does not fully understand is refused rather than diffed: an unknown or a missing field would still produce a plausible-looking answer.

snapshots.description: The snapshot documents to compare, in the order they are reported. At least two: comparing one against nothing has no answer. One of them may have been written by something other than this toolkit — a clean-room implementation stating its own state in the same shape is the case this exists for.
